interpretation: Fluorination and disconnected structures are review flags, not universal automatic exclusions. Fluorine was determined from parsed atoms; a naive molecular-formula regex overcounted five Fe-containing COCONUT records. The perfluorinated example is incompatible with an ordinary biosynthetic terpene interpretation absent extraordinary source evidence. Missing stored InChIKeys are a data-completeness issue because every row has standard InChI and an InChIKey can be recomputed.
